narrative:
Portage County has 108,194 registered voters, with 57.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 22.7%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.0% of registrants.
